---
title: "Pen Tool Options Widget"
format: html
---

## Overview

`PenToolOptions_Widget` is the options-bar page shown when `MediaToolId::Pen` is active in the Media Viewer left tool strip. It provides Pen tool usage instructions and controls for append-endpoint policy.

## Controls

| Control | State field | Description |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| Append to combo | `LineInteractionPrefs::append_endpoint` | Choose tip, base, or nearest endpoint for Ctrl+click appends |

## Instructions

The widget displays:

- **Ctrl+click** to append a point.
- **Alt+click** to delete the nearest vertex.
- **Right-click** the selected line for additional operations.

Select a line with the **Select** tool before using the Pen tool.

## Related Code

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| `MediaLine_Widget::_addPointToLine` | Appends to the selected line entity using the configured endpoint |
| `MediaLine_Widget::_deleteNearestVertexFromLine` | Removes one vertex by nearest hit-test |
| `SelectToolPrefs::pick_radius_px` | Vertex hit threshold for Alt+click deletion |
| `LineInteractionPrefs::append_endpoint` | Persisted append-endpoint policy |

See also [Media Viewer Tool Strip](MediaToolStrip.qmd) and [Media Viewer Tool Options Bar](MediaToolOptionsBar.qmd).
